description: SIEVE v2 reader x representation response-surface experiment configuration. All experiment parameters live here; no model IDs are hardcoded in code. See v2/README.md and research/idea-v2.md.

evaluation_split.comment: Router claims require both unseen-query and unseen-reader evaluation. Budget 0 denotes an uncapped fixed control.

filtered_raw.comment: Keep turns whose relevance >= relative_threshold * max_relevance.

extractive.comment: Sentence-level extraction; top sentences by relevance, emitted in (memory rank, sentence position) order.

structured_quotes.comment: Fraction of the budget given to the structured block; the remainder goes to the exact-quotes block.

summary.comment: Abstractive summary via injected compile-LLM callable; max_tokens hint derived from budget, floored here.

reader_panel.comment: Weak and mid reader IDs are pinned. Add at least two dated frontier IDs in a run-specific config before making unseen-reader claims.

judge.comment: Judge is run by cli/judge.py unchanged over the runner's run.json output.

compile_model.comment: Default compile-LLM for the summary style. Only used at compile time, never in tests.
